zh: 首页焕新：底部导航改为悬浮胶囊，标签顺序重排，切换更顺手
界面整体风格升级，观感与交互更统一
AI 对话重开 App 后默认开启新对话，历史对话可在抽屉里切回
Product Hunt 产品支持多图，图片可左右滑动浏览
en: Refreshed home screen: floating pill navigation bar with reordered tabs
Refreshed visual style across the app for a more consistent look and feel
AI chat starts a new conversation after you reopen the app; earlier chats remain in the drawer
Product Hunt items now show multiple images you can swipe through
